task.title: Change the motor’s status to ‘Repairing’
task.shortdesc: If a motor or motor component is being repaired or replaced, you must update the

context.p: If a motor or motor component is being repaired or replaced, you must update the motor’s status manually on the SMS mobile app. No data is sent to the ADI OtoSense™ Server while the motor is being repaired.

ul.li: Update the details of the new part or new motor in the SMS mobile app. See Section 6.1 Repairing or replacing a motor of the Installation Guide.
Mark the motor as ‘repaired’ on the SMS web application.

context.p: A new learning process will begin after a motor has been repaired.
To set a motor’s status to ‘Repairing’:

step.cmd: Log in to the SMS mobile application.
Tap Motors on the bottom menu.
Select the corresponding location associated with the motor.
From the subsequent screens, select the corresponding plant, process, and motor name.

info.p: The motor’s information page is displayed.

step.cmd: Scroll up and tap SET TO REPAIRING.

result.p: The motor’s status is set to repairing.
